answer: Submissions are gated by a behavioral-entropy floor. The ledger scores the entropy of answers a wallet has graded: distinct hashes, theme variety, and timing spread. A sybil clone mirrors its siblings and stays below the floor, so it cannot post until it grades a genuine spread. Honest reading naturally crosses the threshold, building a reef of varied work that becomes a haven the farm cannot fake. Because ferrous, repetitive grading earns no entropy, each clone must do real, distinct effort. Attacker cost: N separate grading histories, not one scripted loop.
